label: IGH / CRLF2

sections.text: IGH is the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus, with potent B-lineage regulatory elements.
CRLF2 encodes a receptor subunit that pairs with IL7R to mediate thymic stromal lymphopoietin signaling.
IGH regulatory elements drive CRLF2 overexpression, increasing cytokine-receptor signaling, often with cooperating JAK-pathway lesions. The event occurs in B-ALL and is enriched in Ph-like disease.
